description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWordGate functionality in the SwabbleKit project, specifically testing matching logic, command extraction, and handling of multi-word triggers within wake word detection segments.

classes.name: WakeWordGateTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases to verify the behavior of wake word detection and command parsing logic.

methods.name: matchRequiresGapAfterTrigger
methods.description: Tests that the wake word trigger requires a gap after the trigger word before a command can be recognized.

methods.name: matchAllowsGapAndExtractsCommand
methods.description: Tests that a valid trigger followed by a command is correctly matched and extracted.

methods.name: matchHandlesMultiWordTriggers
methods.description: Verifies that multi-word triggers are correctly handled by the wake word detection logic.

methods.name: commandTextHandlesForeignRangeIndices
methods.description: Ensures that command text is correctly extracted even when segment ranges originate from outside the original text's range.
